title: Writing to a marked cell
statement: Given an optional write instruction and a recursive record symbol, update the content only when the symbol represents a work cell whose mark is true. In that case, use the instructed content when present and otherwise preserve the existing content; preserve the mark, and leave every other kind of symbol unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: An optional write instruction, possibly specifying blank or a binary symbol
